provision.quote: passed by the Respondent No.2 under Section 73 (1) of the Maharashtra Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017

date.quote: show cause notice dated 18.06.2025 was issued

events.quote: The petitioner’s case was selected for scrutiny under Section 61 of the MGST Act and accordingly, notice dated 07.05.2024 was issued to the petitioner
Thereafter a show cause notice dated 18.06.2025 was issued to the petitioner
The petitioner replied the show cause notice on 16.07.2025
Thereafter, after hearing the petitioner, adjudication order was passed on 26.12.2025
By the impugned adjudication order dated 26.12.2025, tax liability of Rs. 2,06,46,142/- including interest and penalty is imposed on the petitioner.

document_contents.quote: stating that the TDS turnover as per GSTR 2A returns was Rs. 3,19,75,708/- and the unpaid tax on the same was Rs. 57,55,627/-.
explaining that the services provided by the petitioner to the Municipal Corporation, Aurangabad was due to misconception.

defects_argued.quote: Since the same is contrary to the provision sub-Section (7) of Section 75, the impugned notice and the adjudication order cannot be sustained in the facts of the present case.
The impugned order is unsustainable on this ground also.

outcome.quote: The impugned show cause notice dated 18.06.2025 as well as the impugned order dated 26.12.2025 are hereby quashed and set aside.
